description: Build a valid .ics calendar file from dated events and recurring classes, with reminders. Inputs: events (each with title, date, optional start_time, end_time, type, course, location and notes), classes (each with course, weekdays, start_date, end_date, start_time and optional end_time, location, holidays and reading_weeks), reminders_minutes (whole minutes before each event, default 60), calendar_name and optional output_path. Each class becomes one weekly recurring event with holidays and reading weeks removed. The tool checks the file before returning it. Example prompt: "Make an .ics file for my course with a reminder one day before each assignment."

calendar_name.description: Name shown in the calendar app. Defaults to "Course calendar".

classes.description: Recurring classes to add as weekly events.

course.description: Course name or code, such as BIO 101.

end_date.description: Last date of the term as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: Class end time as HH:MM or 2:30 PM. It must be after start_time.

holidays.description: Holiday dates or ranges, such as "2026-10-12" or "2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16".

reading_weeks.description: Reading week dates or ranges, such as "2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16".

start_date.description: First date of the term as YYYY-MM-DD.

start_time.description: Class start time as HH:MM or 2:30 PM.

title.description: Title for the calendar event. Defaults to the course name plus class.

weekdays.description: Days the class meets, as names or codes, such as "Tuesday", "Tue" or "TU".

events.description: Dated events such as assignments and exams.

date.description: Date of the event as YYYY-MM-DD, or a date such as September 15, 2026.

end_time.description: End time as HH:MM or 2:30 PM. It must be after start_time.

start_time.description: Start time as HH:MM or 2:30 PM. Leave it out for an all day event.

title.description: Title of the event, such as Assignment 1 or Midterm exam.

type.description: The kind of event. Defaults to other.

output_path.description: Optional file path. When it is passed, the calendar is written there as a .ics file.

reminders_minutes.description: Reminder times in whole minutes before an event. Defaults to [60]. Pass an empty array for no reminders.

name: build_ics

class_count.description: How many recurring classes the calendar holds.

class_meetings.description: How many class meetings the recurring events produce after skips.

errors.description: Problems found by the checks. Empty when the calendar is valid.

event_count.description: How many single events the calendar holds.

ics.description: The calendar file as text, with CRLF line breaks.

output_path.description: The file path the calendar was written to, or null when no path was passed.

valid.description: True when the calendar passed the built in checks.

title: Build an ics calendar
